known_risks: 中文：强制 JP v96 中普通大风压效果 ID 的三个直接检查；煌黑龙等特殊或脚本化吹飞可能绕过普通风压判定，因此对这类吹飞无效不能单独证明映射错误。 / English: Forces the three direct JP-v96 checks for ordinary high wind pressure; special or scripted knockback such as Alatreon's may bypass the normal wind-pressure checks, so failure against that knockback alone does not prove a mapping error.
license: MIT for repository-authored metadata and patch source; no game assets included.
summary: 中文：把 3DS 静态 ARM 金手指 #44“风压（大）无效”转换为 JP v96 Wii U PPC 固定地址补丁；默认关闭，状态为 Runtime Experimental。 / English: Converts 3DS static ARM cheat #44 "Windproof (High)" into fixed-address JP-v96 Wii U PPC patches; disabled by default and classified Runtime Experimental.
